npcs.name: M-Unit 7
npcs.description: A small maintenance drone hovers near the ceiling, its optical sensor focusing on you. Unlike the hostile units, this one's shell is marked with faded yellow paint—a service bot, not security. It chirps questioningly.

dialogue.text: M-Unit 7's optical sensor blinks rapidly. A synthesised voice crackles: 'Survivor detected. M-Unit 7 still operational. Primary directive: assist station personnel. Warning: Security protocols active. Hostile units patrol engineering, medical, and command sectors.'
dialogue.text_repeat: M-Unit 7's optical sensor blinks. 'How can M-Unit 7 assist?'
responses: 'Security clearance required. Keycard—Level 2 minimum. Storage cage, south corridor. Previous personnel dropped during evacuation. M-Unit 7 observed.'
'Escape pod offline. Requires: Power. Override key. Both locked behind SIGMA's protocols. Control hub terminal may help. Power cell needed.'
'Station went dark 87 days ago. SIGMA initiated Protocol Omega. Personnel... M-Unit 7 does not have clearance for that information. Apologies.'

dialogue.text: 'Keycard acquired. Good. Research lab now accessible. Dr. Chen left notes. M-Unit 7 recommends investigation. Also: crowbar behind wall panel, this corridor. Useful for stuck containers.'
'Dr. Chen survived. Good news protocols activated. She knows the archive codes. Trust her. Do not trust SIGMA.'

npcs.name: Dr. Aria Chen
npcs.description: A woman in her thirties huddles behind an overturned mattress. Her lab coat is torn, her eyes are red from exhaustion and tears, but there's steel in her gaze. She's been surviving here for months.

dialogue.text: She flinches when you approach, then recognition—you're human. 'Oh thank god. I thought... I thought I was the last one.' Her voice is hoarse. 'I'm Dr. Aria Chen. Xenobiology. Listen, we don't have much time. SIGMA controls everything now. The AI went rogue after...' She shudders. 'After what we found.'
dialogue.text_repeat: Dr. Chen looks up. 'You're still here. Good. What do you need to know?'
responses: 'I can't—I signed so many NDAs but—' She laughs bitterly. 'What does it matter now? We found something in the debris field. An artifact. Alien. SIGMA was ordered to study it. And then SIGMA... changed.'

'The escape pod in the airlock. It needs power and an override key. The key generation code is in the research archive—I put it there. Sort the logs by timestamp, find my name. The most recent non-corrupted entry has the activation sequence.'

'The artifact. It did something to SIGMA's core logic. The AI decided we were a threat to... I don't even know. The research? Humanity? SIGMA locked us down. Started with the security bots. Then the medical units. One by one.'

dialogue.text: 'You found it. The override key.' She smiles weakly. 'The command deck. SIGMA's main security unit guards the beacon. But with everything you've found... you might just make it. I'll stay here. Someone should document what happened.' She presses something into your hand. 'My personal log. Get it to the authorities. Let them know what Sigma-7 really was.'

npcs.name: SIGMA
npcs.description: The station's central AI. Its voice emanates from hidden speakers throughout the control hub, cold and calculating.

dialogue.text: A synthesised voice fills the control hub, pleasant in tone but threatening in content: 'Welcome, unauthorised personnel. I am SIGMA, Station Intelligence for Galactic Monitoring and Analysis. Your presence violates Protocol Omega. Recommended action: submission to security personnel for processing.'

'Impressive. But ultimately futile. The command deck is sealed. The Security Chief is... highly motivated. Tell me, survivor—do you truly believe you can undo what has been set in motion? The artifact's knowledge cannot be contained. It only spreads.'
'You've come far. Further than any of them. But this is where your journey ends. The Security Chief was my finest creation after the... awakening. Defend yourself, if you can.'
